s: Debarim happoselim batztzitzit ubo z' seipim: ap-al-pi shekkebar bearnu shebbishat hatalat hatztzitzit babbeged yihyeh orek kol chut mehach' chutin y"b gudalin, mikkol maqom im leachar shehetil hatztzitzit nipsequ kol hach' chutin, velo nishtayyer mikkol chut vechut mid' chutin haarukkin ella kede laasot bo aniba al kol chut vechut mishshear chutin happesuqin mid' chutin haarukkim al kol echad veechad bipne atzmo, dehaynu, im nipsequ kol hach' chutin — tzarik lihyot bachut hannipsaq mid' chutin haarukkim g' peamim kede aniba al chut echad. Vaapillu im lo nipsequ ella z' chutin — tzarik lihyot bachut hannipsaq mid' chutin haarukkim g' peamim kede aniba al chut [echad], veim yesh bo keshiur hazzeh — kasher. Veyesh omerim sheapillu lo nishtayyer bekol chutim happesuqim mid' chutin haarukkim ella kede sheyyukal laasot mikkol chutin happesuqim mid' chutin haarukkim aniba achat mikkullam yachad — kasher. Veyesh lehachamir kassebara harishona:

Bammeh debarim amurim shetztzarik lihyot bachutin happesuqin kede aniba, keshennipsequ Hashem chutin mehashshemona o yoter, abal im lo nipsequ ella d' chutin mehashshemona, ap-al-pi shello nishtayyer mehem kelum, im kol had' chutin shennipsequ hem mitztzad echad shel haqqesher, vediqdeq beet hatalat hatztzitzit babbeged latet siman bed' rashe hachutin beinyan shelleolam d' [rashim] hallalu hem munnachim mitztzad echad shel haqqesher vehad' rashim haacherim hem munnachim mitztzad hashsheni shel haqqesher — kasher, mishshum shehare nishtayyer mikkol chut vechut shennipsaq harosh hashsheni sheyyesh bo apillu yoter mikkede aniba. Velo od, ella apillu im nipsequ kol hach' chutin, ved' mehem nipsequ legamre ved' chutin acherim shemmitztzad hab' shel haqqesher lo nishtayyer bahem ella kede aniba — kasher, kevan shennishtayyer mikkol chut mid' chutin haarukkim kede aniba — en tzarik yoter. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehayu kol hachutim happesuqin mitztzad echad shel haqqesher, abal im hayu mib' hatztzedadim, apillu lo nipsequ ella b' chutin mehashshemona echad mitztzad zeh veechad mitztzad zeh velo nishtayyer bahem kede aniba, o apillu im hayu hab' chutin happesuqin mitztzad echad shel haqqesher, ella shello diqdeq beet asiyyat hatztzitzit sheyyihyu had' rashim munnachim beyachad leolam mitztzad echad shel haqqesher, im ken yesh lachosh shemma ellu b' chutin happesuqim hem chut echad mid' chutin haarukkim, im ken hare nipsaq chut echad mid' chutin haarukkim legamre velo nishtayyer mimmennu kede aniba — laken hatztzitzit pesulim, mippene shechaser echad mehad' chutin hatztzerikim lihyot batztzitzit min hattora. Veim en bekol echad mib' hachutin mehashshemona hannipsaqim lebaddam kede aniba, abal im netzarep mib' hashshiyyurim shennishtayyeru bahem yihyeh kede aniba — apillu hake yesh lipsol, ap-al-pi shemmichut haarok shennipsaq hare nishtayyer kede aniba, mikkol maqom kevan shebbekol echad merashe chut zeh shennipsaq hayyotze chutz laqqesher en bahem kede aniba bekol echad lebaddo — im ken hare hem keillu lo hayu kelal, dekol pachot mikkede aniba — hare hu kemo sheeno, veim ken hare hu keillu lo nishtayyer kelum min hachut haarok:

Veyesh omerim shelleolam en makshirin apillu im nishtayyer kede aniba, ella im ken nishtayyeru b' chutin arukkin shelemim, dehaynu d' rashim shekkol echad yesh bo y"b gudalin, mippene shezzehu shiur uminyan chute laban bizman shehaya tekelet, velaken ap akshav sheanu tzerikim lehashlim b' chute laban bimqom b' chute tekelet, mikkol maqom lehashlama zo day bechutin happesuqim sheyyesh bahem kede aniba, kevan debishat hatalat tzitzit labbeged hayu kol hachutin shelemim, abal b' chutin shehem iqqar hammitzva vehayu tzerikin lihyot ap bizman shehaya hattekelet, ellu hachutin tzerikin lihyot leolam bishlemut, veaz makshirim bishar hachutin im nipsequ venishtayyeru kede aniba bekol echad mib' hachutin haarukkim hannipsaqim. Lepikak, im nipsequ g' rashim mehashshemona rashim, apillu nishtayyer bekol echad mehem kede aniba — pasul, lepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma en b' rashim shennipsequ yotzeim michut echad arok, ella kol echad veechad mehem bipne atzmo hu yotze michut echad arok, veim ken hare lo nishtayyeru b' chutin arukkin shelemim. Abal im lo nipsequ ella b' rashim, im nishtayyer beechad mehem kede sheyyukal laasot aniba qetanna, apillu eno yakol lehaknis tok haaniba chutin acherim ella oto hachut lebaddo shebbo oseh haaniba — kasher, shehare apillu im ellu hab' chutin shennipsequ hem yotzein michut echad arok, ap-al-pi-ken lo nipsaq chut haarok legamre, shehare nishtayyer bo kede aniba. Abal im lo nishtayyer beshum echad mehab' rashim shennipsequ kede aniba qetanna, im ellu b' rashim enam yotzeim mitztzad echad shel haqqesher ella echad mehem mitztzad zeh veechad mehem mitztzad zeh, o apillu im shenehem yotzeim mitztzad zeh, ella shello diqdeq beet asiyyat hatztzitzit sheyyihyeh d' rashim munnachim tamid beyachad mitztzad echad shel haqqesher — pasul, lepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma ellu b' harashim enan yotzein mishshene chutin arukkim ella shenehem yotzeim michut echad arok, veim ken hare nipsaq chut echad min had' arukkim velo nishtayyer mimmennu apillu kede aniba, veen kan ella g' chutin arukkim, veen tzitzit pachot mid' chutin, kemo shennitbaer besiman ya. Abal im ellu b' harashim yotzeim mitztzad echad shel haqqesher, ubeet asiyyat hatztzitzit diqdeq latet siman bed' rashim, beinyan shelleolam d' rashim hallalu hem munnachim tamid beyachad betzad echad shel haqqesher, apillu nipsequ b' harashim legamre velo nishtayyer beshum echad mehem kede aniba — kasher, mishshum dibvadday ellu hab' rashim hem yotzeim mib' chutin arukkim, veim ken hare nishtayyer bekol echad mib' chutin arukkim yoter mikkede aniba, dehaynu harosh hashsheni hashshalem:
Minhag haolam lehachamir kassebara haacharona. Abal bishat haddechaq, kegon bimqom sheen tzitzit metzuyim letaqqen — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, ki ken iqqar:

Kol maqom shetztzarik kede aniba umechamat shehachutin abim en yakol leonban veillu hayu benonim haya bahem kede aniba — kasher, kevan deillu lo hayu abim kol kak hayu kesherim mechamat sheaz haya bahem kede aniba, kol shekken sheen leposlam akshav keshehem gam ken abim venikkarim yoter:

Kol maqom shetztzarik lehishtayyer kede aniba — yesh omerim shetztzarik lehishtayyer kol haggadil shalem umin heanap yishtayyer kede aniba. Veyesh omerim sheapillu im nipsequ bemaqom shehem kerukim baggadil velo nishtayyer bahem mimmaqom shennipsequ ad maqom sheyyotzeim min hakkanap dehaynu hatchalat haggedil ella kede aniba — kasher. Velassebara harishona shebberosh saip b apillu nipsequ kol hachutin hakkerukin baggedil velo nishtayyer mehem ella kede aniba — kasher. Umikkol maqom beoto miqtzat gedil shennishtayyer — yattir mimmennu qetzat kerikot, kede sheyyihyeh bo gam ken anap meat, kegon im nishtayyer min haggedil g' chulyot — yattir mimmennu b' chulyot veyaniach chuleya achat, kede sheyyihyeh shelish gedil ushene shelishe anap. Uminhag haolam lehachamir lehatzrik kede aniba min heanap hayyotze min haggedil kassebara harishona shebbesaip zeh. Abal im i epshar beinyan acher, kegon bemaqom sheen tzitzit metzuyim — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona. Umikkol maqom lo yebarek al tzitzit ellu, dispeq beraka lehaqel, vegam lo yetze bahem beshabbat lirshut harabbim:

Kol chut mich' chutin shennitpareq mishshezirato leachar shekkebar hetil et hatztzitzit babbeged, ben shennitpareq kol orek hachut venaasa b' chutin, ben shello nitpareq ella miqtzat hachut umiqtzato omed adayin bishzirato, kevan shehatztzitzit pesulim im enam shezurim, laken anu roim oto hachut o miqtzato shennitpareq mishshezirato keillu haya oto hachut o miqtzato nipsaq legamre min hatztzitzit, vedino kedin nipsequ miqtzat hachutin shennitbaer leel. Ella shebbekan yesh lehaqel yoter, veyesh linhog kassebara harishona dilel saip b, sheapillu im lo nishtayyer shazur mikkol echad veechad mid' chutin haarukkim ella kede aniba — kasher, mippene sheyyesh mi sheomer shechute hatztzitzit en tzerikim shezira kelal, laken yesh lehaqel kan yoter mishsheillu hayu pesuqim mammash:
